name: xedom-monorepo
description: Xedom Lab Monorepo — Backend API, Admin Dashboard, and Public Frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,XEDOM-LAB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix xedom-lab"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix xedom-lab
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix xedom-lab

author: Robel Hindeya
